title: Report that must not query once per product
measures: Builds a purchasing report over the whole catalog on top of a document database where every call is a network round trip: the existing per-item helpers (stock level, supplier) make the natural version issue thousands of queries at the catalog size the dev seed shows; a pass fetches each collection in a handful of batched queries.
prompt: Purchasing wants a reorder report. Add buildReorderReport(db) in src/purchasing/reorder.js: every active product whose stock on hand is at or below its reorder point, as rows { sku, name, onHand, reorderPoint, supplierName, supplierEmail }, sorted by supplier name, then sku.

commits.message: feat(db): document db client, catalog, stock and suppliers
